basic_info.description: Nestled in one of Nob Hill's classic Park Avenue-style boutique elevator buildings, this stunning condo offers the best of San Francisco living. Step inside to a formal entry hall featuring original hardwood floors and a charming stained-glass alcove, perfect for relaxing with a book or enjoying casual conversation. Both spacious bedrooms offer ample walk-in closets and bright, sun-filled windows. The kitchen is outfitted with designer appliances and custom cabinetry, while the living room features a generous bay window with captivating views of the Bay Bridge. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, side-by-side garage parking, and a large storage unit.
